items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15, all volumes (18, 1, 1, 10 mix) handled by p20 within 1–20 µL; correct labware/labels; simulator passed with no overdispense or empty-aspirate issues.

Fresh tip per colony and per primer (pick_up inside each loop, drop_tip after); one tip for master mix into empty wells; tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end, no_cross_contamination checks all pass.
Steps 1–4 are done in order with the right quantities; the colony step mixes 3x after dispensing and the thermocycling comment is recorded, so I found no deviation.
Loop over all 96 pcr_plate wells aspirates and dispenses 18 µL from reservoir A1; end_state:pcr_plate passes.
Zip of colony_plate and primer_plate wells to pcr_plate wells transfers 1 µL each with p20; end-state checks pass.
protocol.comment records sealing and 98C 30 s; 30x[98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the task order and quantities, uses the p20 correctly, and takes a fresh tip for every colony and primer. All measured checks pass and the thermocycling program is recorded as a comment.
